title: Document accepted.toml freshness gate in constraints-map.md
description: sutra/308 wired .sutra/accepted.toml as the source of truth (DB demoted to a reproject-on-read cache) with a freshness gate at every read/write surface, but docs/constraints-map.md still describes the old DB-authoritative waiver/ack model. Update it to cover: accepted::refresh_cache (migrate THEN ensure_cache_fresh) as the read-surface gate (evaluate_dd, orient, list); the guard stale path (evaluate_raw -> resolve_waivers_for_guard when is_cache_fresh_conn is false); write actions writing the file + reproject (waive/baseline/ack) and key-based removal (unwaive/unack); and CheckOutcome.accepted_warnings surfacing. Key files: src/constraints/accepted.rs, src/constraints/check.rs (evaluate_dd/evaluate_raw), src/tools/constraints.rs.
